title: Xuanzang returns to Chang'an
subtitle: A turning point from travel to translation institutions
shortSummary: After Xuanzang returned to Chang'an, pilgrimage experience became long-term work in translation, teaching and monastic institutions.
curatorialDescription: The timeline treats the return as the point where route and urban institutions meet, rather than the endpoint of a legend.
researchNote: Exact year, arrival route, translation projects and differences among biographical versions still need verification.
